senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Five or relating to five, made of five, bought with five, &c.
m. (-कः)
Any collection or aggregate of five, a five.
n. (-कं)
A field of battle.
E.
पञ्च five, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A particular ceremony in which ghee is offered in five cups.
E.
पञ्च five, कपाल a concave piece of pottery skull-shaped.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Relating to or part of that oblation which is offered in five cups.
E.
पञ्चकपाल, q. v., अण् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
Five actions of the body, vomiting, evacuation by bleeding or by stool, diseased excretion of fæces or purging, and blowing the nose.
E.
पञ्च five, कर्म्मन् an act.

ind.
Five times.
E.
पञ्च, and कृत्वसुच् aff.

m. (-णः)
A pentagon.
E.
पञ्च, and कोण an angle.

n. (-लः)
The aggregate of five spices, viz. Long pepper, its root, Chai or Piper Cavya, Plumbago, and dry ginger.
E.
पञ्च five, and कोल pepper.

m. plu. (-षाः)
The five sheathes supposed to invest the soul, or the Annamaya koṣa that supported by food the gross form; the Prāṇamaya koṣa, the organs of action; the Manomaya koṣa, the organs of perception, with the manas or mind; the Vijñānamaya, the same with the Buddhi or intellect; and the Ānandamaya, consisting of the elements of identity and divine wisdom.
E.
पञ्च, and कोष a sheath.

nf. (-द्वं-द्वी)
A collection of five beds.
E.
पञ्च five, and खद्वा bed.

n. (-वं)
A collection of five cows.
E.
पञ्च, and गौ a cow.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having five cows.
E.
पञ्चगव, and धन wealth.

n. (-व्यं)
Five articles derived from the cow; milk, curds, clarified butter, cow's urine, and cow-dung.
E.
पञ्च five, and गव्य, from गौ a cow.

mf. (-णः-णा-णं)
Five times, five-fold.
E.
पञ्च, and गुण multiplying.

m. (-प्तः)
1 A tortoise, a turtle.
2 The atheistical system of the Bauddhas.
E.
पञ्च five, (members, &c.) गुप्त concealed.

mfn. (-गौः-गौः-गु)
Bought with five cows.
E.
पञ्च, and गो a cow.

n. (-रं)
A form of metre, in which the line contains sixteen syllables.

m. (-रः)
A Bauddha saint and legislator; also named MAÑJUGHOṢA, apparently the teacher of this doctrine in Nepal.
E.
पञ्च spreading, चीर rags.

f. (-डा)
One of the nymphs of heaven.
E.
पञ्च, and चूडा a top knot.

m. (-नः)
1 Man in general, a man.
2 The name of a demon, whose bones became the Conch, Pāñcajanya, the shell of KṚṢṆA.
f. (-नी)
An assemblage of five persons.
E.
पञ्च five, (elements,) and जन who is born.

m. (-नः)
1 An actor, a mimic, a buffoon.
2 The chief of five men.
E.
पञ्च five, and जन a man, or पञ्चजन man, and ख aff.

m. (-नः)
A Buddha or Bauddha sanctified teacher.
E.
पञ्च five, (organs,) and ज्ञान knowledge.

mfn. (-ञ्चत्)
Five.
E.
पचि to spread, अति aff.

nf. (-क्षं-क्षी)
An assemblage of five carpenters.
E.
पञ्च, and तक्ष a carpenter.

n. (-त्वं)
1 The five elements collectively.
2 (In the Tantras,) The five essentials of certain rites; or wine, meat, fish, sexual intercourse, and mystic gesticulations.
E.
पञ्च, and तत्व an element.

n. (-चं)
The five subtile rudiments of the five elements.
E.
पञ्च, and तन्मात्र element.

m. (-पाः)
An ascetic, who, in the hot weather, sits amongst four fires, and has the sun for the fifth.
E.
पञ्च, and तपस् penance.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Having five parts or limbs.
2 Five.
E.
पञ्च five, and तयप् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Death, dying, i. e. the separation of the five elements of whose aggregate the body consists.
2 The nature or condition of five, the aggregate of five or five times.
3 The five elements collectively, earth, air, fire, water, and Ākāśa.
E.
पञ्च five, and तल् abstract aff.

f. (-र्थी)
1 Any five principal places of pilgrimage, especially Viśrānti, Saukara, Naimiṣa, Prayāga, and Puṣkara.
2 Bathing on the day of the equinox.
E.
पञ्च, and तीर्थ a shrine.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Death.
2 The state or being of five.
3 The coexistence of the five elements.
3 An aggregate, &c. of five.
E.
पञ्च five, and त्व aff.: see पञ्चता.

m. (-थुः)
1 Time.
2 The Koil or Indian cuckoo.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Fifteen or fifteenth.
f. (-शी)
The fifteenth day of a half month, full or new moon.
E.
पञ्च five, दशन् ten, aff. डत्.

mfn. plu. (-श)
Fifteen.
E.
पञ्च five, and दशन् ten.

m. (-र्घः)
Marks on five parts of the body, the arms, eyes, belly, nose, and breast.

ind.
In five ways, five-fold.
E.
पञ्चन् five, and धा aff.

mfn. plu. (-ञ्च)
Five.
E.
पचि to spread, Uṇādi aff. अन्.

m. (-खः)
1 An elephant.
2 A tortoise.
3 A tiger.
4 Any animal having five toes or claws.
f. (-खी)
A lizard.
E.
पञ्च five, नख nail.

m. (-दः)
The Panjab, or country of five rivers, viz. the Śatadru, Vipāśā, Irāvatī, Candrabhāgā and Vitastā.
E.
पञ्च, नदी a river, ट aff.

n. (-म्बं)
Five parts of the Nimb tree; the flowers, fruit, leaves, bark, and root.
E.
पञ्च five, and निम्ब the Nimb, (Melia azadiracta.)

f. (-नी)
A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, chess, &c.
E.
पञ्च five, नी to get, aff. क्विप्.

n. (-नं)
Waving four things before an idol; a lamp, a lotus, cloth, a mango or betel leaf, and then falling prostrate.
E.
पञ्च, and नीराजन presentation.

m. (-खः)
Five kinds of animals allowed to be killed and eaten, the hare, porcupine, alligator, rhinoceros, and tortoise.
E.
पञ्च, and पञ्चनख a five-toed animal.

n. (-वं)
The aggregate of five sprouts; viz. of the spondias, rose-apple, Bel or marmelos, citron, and wood-apple.
E.
पञ्च five, and पल्लव a new shoot.

f. (-र्णी)
A small shrub.

n. (-त्रं)
1 Five plates collectively.
2 A Śrāddha in which offerings are made in five vessels.
E.
पञ्च five, and पात्र a vessel.

m. (-दः)
A temple with four pinnacles and a steeple.
E.
पञ्च, and प्रसाद a palace.

m. plu. (-णाः)
The five airs supposed to be in the body, and necessary to life.
E.
पञ्च, and प्राण vital air.

m. (-न्धः)
A fine equal to the fifth part of any thing lost or stolen.
E.
पञ्च five, and बन्ध binding.

m. (-द्रः)
1 A horse with five auspicious marks; or spotted on the chest, back, face, and flanks.
2 A sauce or condiment of five vegetables.
E.
पञ्च five, and मद्र fortunate.

n. (-तं)
The five elements; earth, air, fire, water, Ākāśa.
E.
पञ्च, and भूत an element.

m. (-त्मा)
Man as formed of the five elements.
E.
पञ्चभूत, and आत्मन् one with.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
1 Fifth.
2 Beautiful, pleasing.
3 Dexterous, clever.
m. (-मः)
1 One of the seven musical notes; the seventh, called Pañcama, from being said to be formed by air drawn from five places; the navel, the breast, the heart, throat, and forehead.
2 One of the Rāgas or modes of music.
f. (-मी)
1 A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāṇḍus.
2 A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. a chess board.
3 The fifth day of a half month.
E.
पञ्चन् five, and डट् aff. with मट् augment.

n. (-रं)
The five essentials of the left hand Tantra ritual; Madya wine, Māṃsa flesh, Matsya fish, Maithuna copulation, Mudrā gesticulation.
E.
पञ्च, and मकार the letter M,; all beginning with that letter.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having the fifth of any thing.
E.
पञ्चम, and मतुप् aff.

m. plu. (-ज्ञाः)
The five great sacraments of the Hindus, or the worship of spirits, progenitors, gods, Vedas, and mankind, by offerings of perfumes and flowers, obsequial rites, oblations with fire, the study of the Vedas, and hospitality.
E.
पञ्च five, महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

m. (-रः)
The son of BALADEVA.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of five Māṣas, relating to, worth, amounting to five Māṣas.
E.
पञ्च, माष a measure of silver, ठक् aff.

m. (-स्यः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
पञ्चम the musical note, and आस्य mouth.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Being in the fifth year of one's age.
E.
पञ्चम, and इनि aff.

m. (-खः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A lion.
E.
पञ्च five, and मुख face.

f. (-द्रा)
Five gestures to be made in the usual presentation of offerings to an idol.
E.
पञ्च, and मुद्रा gesture.

n. (-त्रं)
The urine of the cow, goat, sheep, buffalo, and ass.
E.
पञ्च, and मूत्र urine.

n. (-लं)
The assemblage of five roots, the Bel, Premna longifolia, Cassia, Gmelina arborea, and the Trumpet flower.
f. (-ली)
A similar aggregate of five roots, considered as the smaller one, viz. Hedysarum gangeticum, H. lagopodioides, Solanum melongena, S. jacquini, and Tribulus lanuginosus.
E.
पञ्च five, मूल a root; the fem. aff. has a diminutive import.

m. plu. (-ज्ञाः)
The five rites of a house-keeper: see पञ्चमहायज्ञ.
E.
पञ्च, and यज्ञ a sacrifice.

n. (-त्नं)
A collection of five precious objects; or gold, a diamond, a pearl, a ruby, an amethyst.
E.
पञ्च, and रत्न a gem.

f. (-सा)
Emblic myrobalan.
E.
पञ्च five, रस flavour, taste.

n. (-णं)
A Purāṇa or mythological poem.
E.
पञ्च five, and लक्षण a mark; a Purāṇa should comprehend five topics; the creation of worlds, their destruction and renovation, the genealogy of gods and heroes, the reigns of the MANUS, and the actions of their descendants.

n. (-णं)
Five kinds of salt.
E.
पञ्च, and लवण salt.

n. (-कं)
Gift of land to the extent requiring five ploughs.
E.
पञ्च, लाङ्गल a plough, कन् aff.

n. (-हं)
A metallic alloy containing five metals; copper, brass, tin, lead, and iron.
E.
पञ्च five, and लोह iron.

m. (-क्त्रः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 A lion.
E.
पञ्च five, and वक्त्र a face.

m. (-टः)
The Brahminical thread as worn across the breast; also पञ्चावट.
f. (-टी)
1 Five trees, the Indian and holy fig, the Bel, Grislea tomentosa, and Asoka, placed or planted in several quarters; or east, west, north, south and south-east.
2 Part of the great southern forest where the Godāvarī rises.
E.
पञ्च, and वट the Indian fig.

m. (-टः)
The sacrificial cord, as worn crossed upon the breast, the ends hanging over the shoulders.
E.
पञ्च spreading, वट to surround, aff. अच्, आङ् prefixed to the root; also पञ्चवट.

m. (-र्गः)
A class of five persons or things.
E.
पञ्च, and वर्ग a class.

n. (-लं)
A collection of the bark of five trees, the Indian and the holy fig, the opposite-leaved fig, the wavy-leaved fig, and a sort of reed; other trees are sometimes taken.
E.
पञ्च five, and वल्कल a bark.

m. (-णः)
KĀMADEVA, the Indian Cupid.
E.
पञ्च five, and वाण an arrow; being armed with five arrows.

m. (-रः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
पञ्च five, and शर an arrow: see the last.

m. (-खः)
The hand.
E.
पञ्च five, शाखा a branch, the five-fingered.

m. (-खः)
1 A lion.
2 The name of a Muni, the son of DHARMA by HIṂSĀ.
E.
पञ्च spreading, शिखा a crest or mane.

n. (-कं)
The bark of five trees.
E.
पञ्च, and शिरीष Mimosa sirisha, ठञ् aff.

mfn. plu. (-षाः-षाः-षाणि)
Five or six.
E.
पञ्च, and षष् six, with डच्. aff.

n. (-कं)
The aggregate of five aromatic vegetable substances; cloves, nutmeg, camphor, aloe wood, and Kakkola.
E.
पञ्च five, सुगन्ध fragrance, कन् added.

m. plu. (-नाः)
The five things in a house by which animal life may be accidentally destroyed; the fire place, the slab on which condiments are ground, the broom, the pestle and mortar, and the waterpot.
E.
पञ्च five, and सूना place of slaughter.

n. (-ग्नि)
1 A collection of five fires, amidst which a devotee performs penance during the summer season; or four fires lighted severally to the north, south, east and west, and the sun over head.
2 Five mystic fires, supposed to be present in the body.
m. (-ग्निः)
1 A householder who maintains five fires, or the domestic one, and one for warming visitors in addition to the other three.
2 One who is acquainted with the doctrine of the five mystic fires.
E.
पञ्च five, and अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Having five limbs or members, five parts or subdivisions, consisting of five things, &c.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Any aggregate of five parts or five things.
3 Five modes of devotion or silent prayer, burnt offering, libations, bathing idols, and feeding Brahmans.
3 An almanac describing solar days, lunar days, and the periods of asterisms, Yogas and Karaṇas.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A tortoise.
2 A horse: see पञ्चभद्र.
3 Reverence by extending the hands, bending the knees and head, and in speech and look.
E.
पञ्च five, अङ्ग body.

m. (-प्तः)
A tortoise.
E.
पञ्च five, अङ्ग limb, and गुप्त hidden; covering his head and legs beneath his shell.

mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं)
Measuring five fingers.
m. (-लः)
The castor-oil plant.
E.
पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger, aff. अच्: the leaves having five lobes compared to fingers.

mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि)
Having five fingers, or finger-like divisions.
E.
पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger.

f. (-पा)
Doing penance with five fires, or four fires and the sun.
E.
पञ्च, and आतप heat.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Very passionate.
m. (-नः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 A lion.
E.
पञ्च five or spreading, आनन a face.

n. (-तं)
1 A mixture of milk, curds, sugar, ghee, and honey.
2 The aggregate of any five drugs of supposed efficacy.
E.
पञ्च, and अमृत ambrosia.

m. plu. (-याः)
Five Śāstras supposed to have proceeded from the five mouths of ŚIVA, constituting the basis of the Tantra ritual.
E.
पञ्च, and आम्नाय a scripture.

n. (-म्लं)
The aggregate of five acid plants; the jujube, pomegranate, sorrel, spondias, and citron.
E.
पञ्च five, and अम्ल sour.

f. (-री)
A chequered cloth for playing draughts upon: see पञ्चाली.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
The planet Mercury.
E.
पञ्च five, अर्च्चिस् a ray.

m. (-लः)
A country in the north of India.
f. (-ली)
1 A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, &c.
2 A doll, a puppet.
3 A style of singing.
E.
पचि to spread, Uṇādi aff. कालच्; also with कन् added पञ्चालिका.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Belonging to, dwelling in, ruling over &c. the country of Pañcāla.
m. (-लः)
1 The sovereign of Pañcāla.
2 The company or association of five trades, the carpenter, weaver, barber, washerman, and shoemaker.
E.
पञ्चाल the country so called, and अण् aff. &c.

m. (-स्थः)
A corpse.
E.
पञ्च five, (elements,) अवस्था state or condition.

f. (-शत्)
Fifty.
E.
पञ्च, with शत् aff. and आ augment.

m. (-स्यः)
A lion.
E.
पञ्च spreading, and आस्य a face.

n. (-यं)
1 The five organs of sense; the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; or those of action, as hands, feet, windpipe, [] anus, and parts of generation.
E.
पञ्च five, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

m. (-षुः)
A name of KĀMADEVA, the Hindū Cupid.
E.
पञ्च five, इषु an arrow.

m. plu. (-ष्माणः)
The five digestive fires supposed to be in the body.
E.
पञ्च, and उष्मन् heat.

mn. (-रः-रं)
A skeleton.
n. (-रं)
1 A cage, an aviary, a dovecot.
2 The ribs.
m. (-रः)
1 The body.
2 The Kali age.
E.
पजि for पिजि to dwell, &c. Uṇādi aff., अरच्; also पिञ्जर.

m. (-टः)
A sort of basket or wicker trap in which fish are caught.
E.
पञ्जर a cage, आखेट hunting.

f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी)
1 The ball or whisp of cotton from which thread is spun.
2 A journal, a register.
3 An almanack.
E.
पजि for पिजि to touch, &c. aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; also पिञ्जि.

f. (-का)
1 The ball or skein of cotton, from which the thread is spun: see the last.
2 A perpetual commentary.
3 A calendar, an almanack.
4 A journal, a register.
5 The register or journal of YAMA, the record of human actions.
E.
कन् added to पञ्जि; also पिञ्जिका.

m. (-कः)
1 A writer, a man of the Kāyastha tribe.
2 An almanack-maker.
E.
पञ्जिका a journal, &c. and कारक. who makes.

m. (-रः)
1 The Kāyastha or scribe.
2 An almanack-maker.
E.
पञ्जी a journal, &c. कर who makes.

m. (-न्यः)
1 KṚṢṆA'S conch.
2 A name of fire.
3 Any shell.
4 A sort of fish, commonly Garae.
E.
पञ्चजन a demon, from whose bones the shell was made, यत् aff.

m. (-रः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
पञ्चजन्य the conch, and धर who has.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to or included in the five great ceremonies.
n. (-कं)
Either of the five great sacraments.
E.
पञ्चयज्ञ, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Consisting or made of the five elements.
E.
पञ्चभूत, and ठञ् aff.

f. (-का)
A doll, a puppet: see पाञ्चालिका.

f. (-का)
A doll, a puppet: see पाञ्चाली.

n. (-कं)
Musical instruments in general, or of five sorts.
E.
पञ्च, शब्द sound, and ठञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A follower or votary of ŚIVA.

f. (-ली)
1 A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāṇḍu princes.
2 A puppet, a doll.
3 Melodious combination of five or six words.
E.
पञ्चाल the country so called, aff. of descent or reference अण्, and fem. aff. ङीप्; coming from that region; also with कन् added, पाञ्चालिका, and by making the second vowel short पाञ्चलिका.
